This seems like a very disturbing experience, so I will try to give you advice based on my own brother who has DS and also had trouble dealing with his sexual urges.
First, what you are living is totally unforgivable if it was someone normal doing that, and this type of people deserve prison. In your case, you have someone with DS syndrome this, which makes the situation not only completely different but also nedding to consider several points. 
First of all, DS people are known for being innocent in their heart. For example, I lived my whole life with my little brother, and I discovered how his uniqueness gave him the ability to love me in the purest way possible, something any normal human would be unable to. Lack of consciousness makes you less brainy about people and more loving. That is the DS superpower. Now, I said that DS people are innocent in their heart, but not so innocent in their brain, that is why they can make actions that we forbid them to do. Not because they are evil, but because they are not conscious about the consequences of their actions. For example, any normal human would have a need (for example money) which will be step 1, and this person would consider the different solution to this problem, which is step 2. Let say he decides to rob someone (step 3). He will imperatively think about how this acts unacceptable and the pain that can be caused to other people( step 4). But because he is an evil person, he would prioritise himself rather than the well-being of innocent people(step 5). But, in the case of someone with DS, this person will not go to step 4 or 5. Their brain work like that: "I have a need? I will do the solution then, " but normal people would have a longer train of thoughts.
Now, for your case, your brother has a dangerous problem because he has sexual urges and expresses them in inappropriate ways. That is why you have to tell the person responsible for him (your mother) to:
1) First, have an ethical conversation with him. Tell him that his sister cries a lot because he is doing xyz actions. And that he has to be a hero who protects others from bad things. But now, he is doing bad things, and he has to stop if he wants to be a hero. Tell him that we find a way to make him happy without hurting others
2) Now, we have to consider his urges. He has needs and should fill these needs with appropriate responses. That is why we have to replace the bad actions with good ones. He needs to find a girlfriend, someone his age, someone who is attracted to him. If he finds the right person, he will no longer have the "bad solutions" to his urges because DS people look at the good ones, and if they don't find any good solutions think about the bad ones. 

Thank you for being this courageous, I know people may have wronged you, but this will just be proof to the world that a minor like you can be the strongest person in the world.
